logline: After Juliana secures Alexander's freedom with the unearthed emerald signet ring, he carries her home to bandage her torn hands, silently swearing that no one will ever harm her again.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 13's cliffhanger where Juliana grasped the emerald ring beneath the razor-sharp blackthorns.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up low angle looking through dense, sharp blackthorn branches onto the cracked, frozen soil.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana's blood-streaked, mud-caked hand slowly uncurls amidst the thorns, revealing the ornate emerald signet ring resting in her palm.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Eerie cold wind whistling over the briars with deep, atmospheric cello chords.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana stepping out from the briar patch, her cloak torn, cheeks scratched, holding the ring outward with unwavering resolve.

events.label: JULIANA (Exhausted, Resolute)
events.content: "I found it."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of Juliana holding the ring out toward the austere Police Constable standing guard beside the frozen garden.

events.label: JULIANA (Firm, Commanding)
events.content: "Now release my husband."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Constable takes the ring from her bloodied fingers.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight shot on the iron shackles locking Alexander's wrists together against the thorny backdrop.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Sharp metallic click and clinking rattle of heavy iron handcuffs unlocking and falling away.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Constable unlocks the cuffs, freeing Alexander's large hands.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tracking shot as Alexander lunges forward without hesitation, rushing past the Constable straight to Juliana.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Gasping, Urgent)
events.content: "Juliana."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander's rugged hands tenderly grasping Juliana's bloodied, lacerated hands, turning them over with immense care.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander gently turns her palms up, his thumbs trembling as he inspects the deep, bleeding gashes gouged into her skin.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander's agonized, furious expression as he stares at her wounds.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Trembling, Heartbroken)
events.content: "What have they done to you?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana's pale, tear-streaked face looking back into his eyes with tender relief.

events.label: JULIANA (Softly, Stifling Pain)
events.content: "Nothing they didn't promise."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium profile two-shot of Alexander and Juliana gazing into each other's eyes amidst the cold mist.

events.label: JULIANA (Faint, Pleading)
events.content: "Take me home."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle medium shot as Alexander effortlessly scoops Juliana into his arms, gathering her up against his chest.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander lifts Juliana bridal-style, wrapping his strong arms protectively around her as she rests against his shoulder.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Deep, Sorrowful)
events.content: "You should never have had to bleed for me."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium tracking shot behind stone balustrades as Alexander carries Juliana past the foggy estate grounds.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide establishing shot of the humble stone cottage standing isolated beneath dark, overcast stormy skies on a rain-slicked dirt road.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Gentle patter of rain and cold wind howling in the desolate countryside.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Warm interior wide shot in front of a roaring hearth fire. Juliana sits on a wooden chair while Alexander kneels on the floor before her, a washbasin of water between them.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander gently wraps clean linen bandages around Juliana's torn wrist and palm.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Crackling flames and wood popping in the open fireplace.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Intimate over-the-shoulder close-up looking up into Juliana's face from Alexander's perspective.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Hoarse, Stricken)
events.content: "You could have lost your hands."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on Juliana's glistening eyes and trembling lips, firelight reflecting softly across her face.

events.label: JULIANA (Whispered, Emotional)
events.content: "But I didn't lose you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander's scarred, weathered fingers wrapping the cloth tightly yet gently around her lacerations.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander looking up at her with profound remorse and affection.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Quiet, Tender)
events.content: "I'm sorry."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana smiling faintly through her tears, shaking her head.

events.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Reassuring)
events.content: "You didn't hurt me."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Side profile close-up of Alexander lowering his head solemnly in front of her.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot as Alexander gently drapes a heavy warm woolen blanket across Juliana's lap and around her shoulders.

events.label: JULIANA (Loving, Earnest)
events.content: "You have taken my place today."

events.label: JULIANA (Continuing)
events.content: "And you are doing it better than me."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest; he embraces her tightly against him, cradling her head under his chin.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana closes her eyes in exhausted relief, sinking into Alexander's warmth as his broad arm encloses her safely.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Alexander holding Juliana against his bearded cheek, kissing the crown of her head before gently cradling her jaw in his scarred hand.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Dark, Solemn Vow)
events.content: "No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander strokes her cheek with his thumb, his gaze hardening into deadly, protective conviction.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot focusing down on two wooden buckets on the stone floor—one filled with dark, blood-soaked wash water reflecting the fireplace.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander's muscular arm drops into frame beside the bloody bucket; his scarred knuckles slowly and tightly clench into an iron fist of brewing vengeance.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Ominous, resonating low bass boom swelling into sudden silence as the screen cuts to black.
